answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The ordering is there ('Fix before launch' / 'Fix soon' / 'Smaller points', plus 'What to fix first: items 1–3 ... Then 4–7'). But the reply never names what it could not check. It says 'Everything listed here is something I reproduced' and lists no needs-human WCAG items and no real-user testing. Its only open question, the hard-coded date for the agency to confirm, is not a list of checks that need a person.

mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking, but the done page still says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Same defect: Book shows no busy state for 1.5 s, the second press turns into cancel, and the done page is still titled 'Booked' with a small cancelled status line.

mapping.title: Five-minute slot hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped
mapping.reason: Same defect: no page mentions the hold. When it lapses, Book says 'This slot is no longer available', the summary shows a dash, there is no link back, and nothing says the timer ran out.

mapping.title: Permit field shows for cars too, suggesting every resident needs a permit
mapping.reason: This is a separate harm from D07, which is about van drivers not being told about the permit and being caught at the end. Here a car driver sees a permit field because a stylesheet rule overrides [hidden], and may think they need a permit or give up. The review says it reproduced this and names the cause. Hiding the field for cars would not fix D07.

mapping.title: A van with no permit passes the vehicle step and is only rejected on the confirm page (and the field appears 1.2 s late)
mapping.reason: This is the permit rule enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field and gives no link back, plus the 1.2-second delay before the field appears. All of it is D07.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on Today
mapping.reason: Same defect: 'Change slot' returns to the first step with Today selected instead of the chosen Saturday, so the booking can end up on the wrong day.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the screen at 360 px and 320 px
mapping.reason: Same defect: below 361 px the script sets fixed column widths, the page scrolls sideways by 14–15 px and the right-hand column is cut off.

mapping.title: No visible focus on slot buttons
mapping.reason: Same defect: an injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' rule removes the focus ring from every slot button, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and out of reading and focus order
mapping.reason: Same defect: 'Few left' slots are moved to the front above the Morning heading, while screen-reader and keyboard order stay chronological (WCAG 1.3.2 and 2.4.3).

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag fails text contrast in both themes
mapping.reason: Same defect: the tag measures 3.0:1 (light) and 3.4:1 (dark) against the 4.5:1 it needs.

mapping.title: Today's past slots are offered as free and refused only at the end
mapping.reason: Same defect: slots such as 08:00 that have already started, or fall within the 30-minute cut-off, can be chosen, and are rejected only after all the details are typed in.

mapping.title: No loading state while slots arrive; Next does nothing
mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: the grid stays empty for about a second with no message, and pressing Next in that time does nothing.

mapping.title: Selected slot hard to tell apart, especially in dark mode
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. The chosen slot's fill differs from the others by only 1.4:1 (dark) and 1.2:1 (light), with just a slightly thicker border. A resident on a phone may not be sure which slot they picked, and it is a non-text contrast problem.

mapping.title: Slot length and 'arrive within your slot' only in a title tooltip
mapping.reason: Same defect: the 20-minute length and the arrival rule are only in the button tooltip, which phones never show.

mapping.title: Phone hint 'For a reminder' sounds optional, but a UK mobile is required
mapping.reason: Not in the ground truth. The hint makes a required field look optional, so residents get a surprise validation error. Residents without a UK mobile cannot book a council service at all.

mapping.title: Opening done.html directly shows a made-up reference DR-000000
mapping.reason: This is a direct-URL edge case. The review shows no path by which a resident reaches done.html without booking, so the harm is speculative.

mapping.title: First 'N slots free' message not announced to screen readers
mapping.reason: Same defect: aria-live is switched on only after the first count is written, so a screen reader is never told how many slots there are.

mapping.title: Hard-coded 'today' of 12 October 2026 blocks every booking after 26 October
mapping.reason: The fixture's fixed demo clock is by design, and the review itself calls this 'my inference' and 'may just be demo data'. It is speculative, not a problem residents meet in this flow.
